info.title: Octobrowser API
info.description: Octo Browser cloud automation API. The Action Log WebSocket stream (wss://app.octobrowser.net/api/v2/automation/ws/action_log) is not expressible in OpenAPI 3.0 and is documented separately in api/action-log.md.

get.description: Get list of profiles with pagination and choosing profile fields to return

schema.title: Password
schema.description: `true` returns only profiles with a password, `false` only profiles without; omit for all.

schema.title: Proxies
schema.description: Proxy UUIDs, comma-separated (e.g. `proxies=<uuid1>,<uuid2>`), or the special token `@no-proxies-filter` to return only profiles without a proxy.

parameters.name: proxies
parameters.x-source: docs.octobrowser.net markdown (comma-separated) + official spec 2026-11 (array); not live-verified

parameters.name: origin_platforms
parameters.x-source: official spec 2026-11 (not live-verified); parameter encoding not verified

delete.description: Delete profiles by uuid (1-100). `skip_trash_bin` defaults to true (permanent delete); false moves them to the trash bin. 200 does not mean all were deleted: check deleted_uuids. If nothing was deleted, returns 404 `not_found` with the four lists in `data`. Required token permission: Delete profiles. The request has a JSON body.

403.description: No permission, or none of the profiles is accessible to the token (profiles.access_error)

404.description: Nothing was deleted: 404 `not_found` ("Profiles not found or active") with the four lists in `data` (live-verified for the all-unknown case)

get.description: Get detailed data of profile

patch.description: Update given parameters for profile by uuid

post.description: Import cookies for not active profile

Transfer profiles by given list of uuids to profile with receiver email,
    with or without profiles proxies.
Only existing profiles will be transferred.

get.description: Return list of exported profile data. The payload is nested: data = {data: [...], total, page}. Required token permission: Transfer profiles.

post.description:
Export profiles by given list of uuids, with or without profiles proxies (export_proxy is required).
Only existing profiles will be exported.
Exported files will be allowed from Get /export endpoint

207.description: Some profiles were not exported: see failed (per official spec, not live-verified)

400.description: Bad Request or validation error (e.g. extra field app_version, missing export_proxy)

get.description: Return exported profile data
List profiles in the trash bin (deleted with `skip_trash_bin: false`), paginated with total_count and page. Required token permission: Delete profiles.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by profile title. An empty value returns 400.

400.description: Validation error (e.g. page_len not in 10/25/50/100, empty search)

403.description: Forbidden: the API token lacks the required permission (no_permission)

post.description: Restore profiles from the trash bin (1-100 uuids). Required token permission: Delete profiles. If nothing was restored the API returns 400 profiles.restore_error with the three uuid lists in data. Profiles whose restore would cost tokens are listed in payment_required_uuids and must be restored in the client.

207.description: Some profiles were not restored: see payment_required_uuids and not_found_uuids (per official spec, not live-verified)

400.description: Nothing restored (profiles.restore_error, data populated) or validation error (e.g. empty uuids)

403.description: No permission, or restoring would exceed the plan's profile limit (profiles.maximum_saved_error; nothing restored)

post.description: Import profiles data. Several data versions allowed. Only existing profiles will be imported
Stop profile without syncing data; unsynced changes are lost. `version` is required: pass the running session version for a consistency check, or `null` to stop the current session.

409.description: Conflict: `version` does not match the running session (profiles.consistency_error), or the profile is not running (profiles.not_started, "Profile is not started")

post.description: Force-stop several profiles in one call. Takes no `version` and performs no consistency check. data.failed lists UUIDs that were not stopped: 207 when only some were stopped, 400 with code profiles.stop_error when none were stopped.
post.x-source: docs.octobrowser.net markdown + live probe 2026-08-17; in official OpenAPI spec since 2026-11

207.description: Multi-Status: only some profiles were stopped; see data.failed (official spec 2026-11 and Postman, not live-verified)

400.description: None were stopped (profiles.stop_error); data.failed lists them

post.description:
Set password for profiles by given list of profiles uuids.
In case of setting new password it is necessary to provide old password
Unset password for profile by given profile uuid. Password required.

get.description: Return tag list

post.description: Create tag only if account has enough slots to create the new one

patch.description: Update given parameters for tag by uuid

get.description: List folders
Return list of permanent proxies (not provider proxies). Every item carries conf, vpn_protocol, syn_mode and external_id (null on non-VPN proxies); VPN items return conf in full.

post.description: Create not temp proxy only if account has enough slots to create the new one. Body is a regular proxy or a VPN proxy (`type: "vpn"` + base64 `conf`). Required token permission: Create proxies.

delete.description: Remove proxy by given uuid. Returns `data: null`. Required token permission: Delete proxies.

patch.description: Update given parameters for proxy by uuid. Regular or VPN form; connection fields on a VPN proxy return 400 proxy.vpn_field_not_applicable. The response omits title and profiles_count for VPN proxies. Required token permission: Edit proxies.

400.description: Bad Request (e.g. proxy.vpn_field_not_applicable) or validation error

get.description: Proxy providers built into Octo Browser (Proxy Shop) available to the team. Not paginated.
Team proxies bought from proxy providers, paginated with total_count and page. Filter by provider and kind.

post.description: Buy 1-100 proxies from a proxy provider; consumes the team's traffic for that provider. Take country, region, city and ISP codes from the location endpoints (region/city/isp optional; isp is mobile only). Required token permission: Create paid proxies.
post.x-source: official spec 2026-11 + Postman 2026-11; success path not live-tested (purchases proxies), validation errors live probe 2026-11-18

400.description: No traffic left (proxy_providers.empty_balance), kind not offered (proxy_providers.invalid), provider unavailable or invalid location (bad_request), or validation error

403.description: No permission, or plan limit of provider proxies reached (proxy.limit_reached)

patch.description: Rename a provider proxy; only title can be changed. Required token permission: Edit proxies.

delete.description: Delete a provider proxy. Returns `data: null`. Required token permission: Delete proxies.

get.description: Countries where the provider offers proxies of the given kind. Codes are provider-specific; pass them back exactly as returned.

400.description: Unknown/unavailable provider (proxy_providers.not_exists), kind not offered by the provider (proxy_providers.invalid), provider API error (bad_request), or validation error

get.description: Mobile carriers (ISPs) of the provider in the country. Codes are provider-specific; pass them back exactly as returned.

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: `code` from Get Countries, case-sensitive (e.g. `US`; `us` returns an empty list).

400.description: Unknown/unavailable provider (proxy_providers.not_exists), kind not offered by the provider (proxy_providers.invalid), provider API error (bad_request), or validation error

get.description: Regions where the mobile carrier is available in the country. Codes are provider-specific; pass them back exactly as returned.

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: `code` from Get Countries, case-sensitive (e.g. `US`; `us` returns an empty list).

400.description: Unknown/unavailable provider (proxy_providers.not_exists), kind not offered by the provider (proxy_providers.invalid), provider API error (bad_request), or validation error

get.description: Cities where the mobile carrier is available in the region. Codes are provider-specific; pass them back exactly as returned.

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: `code` from Get Countries, case-sensitive (e.g. `US`; `us` returns an empty list).

400.description: Unknown/unavailable provider (proxy_providers.not_exists), kind not offered by the provider (proxy_providers.invalid), provider API error (bad_request), or validation error

get.description: Regions where the provider offers residential proxies in the country (may be empty). Codes are provider-specific; pass them back exactly as returned.

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: `code` from Get Countries, case-sensitive (e.g. `US`; `us` returns an empty list).

400.description: Unknown/unavailable provider (proxy_providers.not_exists), kind not offered by the provider (proxy_providers.invalid), provider API error (bad_request), or validation error

get.description: Cities where the provider offers residential proxies in the region. Codes are provider-specific; pass them back exactly as returned.

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: `code` from Get Countries, case-sensitive (e.g. `US`; `us` returns an empty list).

get.description: Get list of renderers for fingerprint data
Get list of screens for fingerprint data
List Android device models usable for mobile fingerprints. The response is not paginated; all models are returned.
get.x-source: docs.octobrowser.net markdown + live probe 2026-08-17; in official OpenAPI spec since 2026-11

get.description: List supported fingerprint platforms: valid os / os_arch / os_version combinations for profile creation. Not paginated; query parameters are ignored. iOS is not listed (iOS profiles cannot be created via the API).
Get team's extentsions

delete.description: Delete team's extensions by given list of uuids (`<id>@<version>` as returned by GET /teams/extensions). Unknown but well-formed ids are silently ignored (per Postman); 200 does not mean anything was deleted. Required token permission: Delete extensions. The request has a JSON body.

400.description: Validation error, e.g. malformed extension id

get.description: List the team's members.
get.x-source: docs.octobrowser.net markdown + live probe 2026-08-17; in official OpenAPI spec since 2026-11

post.description: Invite a new member; the subaccount activates once the emailed invite is accepted. `permissions` is required (omitted individual permissions default to false).
post.x-source: docs.octobrowser.net markdown + live probe 2026-08-17; in official OpenAPI spec since 2026-11; permissions required per live probe 2026-11-18

400.description: Validation error (validation_error envelope), e.g. missing permissions or invalid email

patch.description: Replace a subaccount's permission set (identified by email). Omitted permissions default to false.
patch.x-source: docs.octobrowser.net markdown + live probe 2026-08-17; in official OpenAPI spec since 2026-11

400.description: Validation error (validation_error envelope), e.g. missing permissions or invalid email

delete.description: Remove a team member by email.
delete.x-source: docs.octobrowser.net markdown + live probe 2026-08-17; in official OpenAPI spec since 2026-11

get.description: List pending, not yet accepted invitations.
get.x-source: docs.octobrowser.net markdown + live probe 2026-08-17; in official OpenAPI spec since 2026-11

delete.description: Cancel a pending invitation by recipient email.
delete.x-source: docs.octobrowser.net markdown + live probe 2026-08-17; in official OpenAPI spec since 2026-11

get.description: Current plan, expiration, team balance, profile / team member / API token usage and the current rate-limit budget (rpm, rph). No specific token permission required. Dates are UTC without timezone suffix.

BulkForceStopFailure.title: BulkForceStopFailure
BulkForceStopFailure.description: Partial-failure payload: data.failed lists profile UUIDs that could not be stopped (code profiles.stop_error).

CookieNetscape.title: CookieNetscape
CookieNetscape.description: Domain     Tailmatch  Path  Secure Expires Name  Value

CreateProfileVpnProxyValidator.title: CreateProfileVpnProxyValidator
CreateProfileVpnProxyValidator.description: VPN (WireGuard/AmneziaWG) proxy bound to this profile only. `conf` is the base64-encoded config text with an `Endpoint = host:port` line. The profile's proxy is then returned with `uuid: ""`, `type: "vpn"` and without `conf`; it is not listed in GET /proxies.

isp_code.title: Isp Code
isp_code.description: Optional, mobile only; `code` from Get Mobile ISPs.

CreateProviderProxiesValidator.title: CreateProviderProxiesValidator
CreateProviderProxiesValidator.x-source: official spec 2026-11 + Postman 2026-11; validation (quantity, missing country_code) live probe 2026-11-18

CreateVpnProxyValidator.title: CreateVpnProxyValidator
CreateVpnProxyValidator.description: VPN (WireGuard/AmneziaWG) proxy. conf = base64-encoded config text (up to 16 KB raw) that must contain an `Endpoint = host:port` line; host and port are parsed from it. host/port/login/password/change_ip_url are not accepted (400 extra_forbidden).

skip_trash_bin.title: Skip Trash Bin
skip_trash_bin.description: true (default) deletes permanently; false moves the profiles to the trash bin.

DeleteProfilesSerializer.title: DeleteProfilesSerializer
DeleteProfilesSerializer.description: active_uuids: running, not deleted; protected_uuids: protected against deletion via API (Octo 3.2), not deleted; not_found_uuids: not in the team or not accessible to the token.

ExportProfilesData.title: ExportProfilesData
ExportProfilesData.x-source: live probe 2026-11-18 (app_version rejected as extra_forbidden; export_proxy required)

os_arch.title: Os Arch
os_arch.description: x86 or arm; valid combinations are listed by GET /fingerprint/platforms.

os_version.title: Os Version
os_version.description: Must be one of the versions GET /fingerprint/platforms lists for the os/arch (mac 13/14/15/26, win 10/11, android 12-15); otherwise 400 code validation_error "OS version does not match allowed versions for the platform".

device_type.title: Device Type
device_type.description: Android only. Validated against the chosen device_model; a mismatch or unknown value returns 400 fingerprints.invalid_mobile_type.

screen.title: Screen
screen.description: Screen from GET /fingerprint/screens, format `<width>x<height> @<scale> <SDR|HDR>[ P3][ ext]`, e.g. `1920x1080 @1 SDR`, `1440x900 @2 HDR P3`. A legacy `1920x1080` value is accepted and normalised to `1920x1080 @1 SDR`.

media_devices.title: Media Devices
media_devices.description: Flat `{video_in, audio_in, audio_out}` or `{type: "manual", data: {...}}`; both accepted on create. GET always returns the flat form.
media_devices.x-source: live probe 2026-11-18 (flat and manual forms; real form per official spec)

os.description: Cannot be changed: sending os returns 400 profiles.update_error "You can't update os."

screen.title: Screen
screen.description: Screen from GET /fingerprint/screens, format `<width>x<height> @<scale> <SDR|HDR>[ P3][ ext]`, e.g. `1920x1080 @1 SDR`, `1440x900 @2 HDR P3`. A legacy `1920x1080` value is accepted and normalised to `1920x1080 @1 SDR`.

media_devices.title: Media Devices
media_devices.description: Flat `{video_in, audio_in, audio_out}` or `{type: "manual", data: {...}}`; both accepted on create. GET always returns the flat form.
media_devices.x-source: live probe 2026-11-18 (create); same schema on update per official spec

MediaDevicesManual.title: MediaDevicesManual
MediaDevicesManual.description: Wrapped form of media_devices (official spec); the flat form is equivalent.

MediaDevicesReal.title: MediaDevicesReal
MediaDevicesReal.description: Use the real media devices of the machine.

msg.title: Msg
msg.default: Profiles to transfer are not found

OSVersion.title: OSVersion
OSVersion.description: Union of the versions listed by GET /fingerprint/platforms: win 10/11, mac 13/14/15/26, android 12-15. The version must match the platform (e.g. mac 11 is rejected).

PermanentProxyOut.title: PermanentProxyOut

conf.title: Conf
conf.description: VPN proxies only: the base64 config, returned in full (contains the private key). null otherwise.

PermanentProxyOut.description: Saved proxy. conf, vpn_protocol, syn_mode and external_id are present on every item and null on non-VPN proxies.

proxy.title: Proxy

anyOf.description: Saved proxy uuid as a plain string

proxy.x-source: VPN form: official spec 2026-11 + live probe 2026-11-18; string/null forms: live probe 2026-08-17
proxy.description: A plain uuid string or {"uuid": ...} references a saved proxy; null detaches the proxy.

images_load_limit.title: Images Load Limit
images_load_limit.description: Image size limit in bytes (0-102400000); `null` disables the limit.
images_load_limit.x-source: live-verified 2026-08-20; bounds per official spec 2026-11 (not live-verified)

local_cache.title: Local Cache
local_cache.description: Keep the profile's browser cache locally between sessions.

launch_args.title: Launch Args
launch_args.description: Extra command-line arguments passed to the browser on start.

extra_info.title: Extra Info
extra_info.description: Free-form metadata; must be a JSON object (a string returns 400 "should be JSON-object").

version.title: Version
version.description: Profile version from the start response; `null` stops the current session. Required (send `null` explicitly).
version.x-source: official spec 2026-11 + live probe 2026-11-18 (int, numeric string and null accepted; missing or non-numeric -> 400)

ProfileNotFundOrActiveResp.title: ProfileNotFundOrActiveResp
ProfileNotFundOrActiveResp.description: None of the requested profiles was found: data carries the four uuid lists.

proxy.title: Proxy

anyOf.description: Saved proxy uuid as a plain string

proxy.description: An object updates only the passed fields of the profile's own proxy, or creates one if the profile has none. A plain uuid string or {"uuid": ...} references a saved proxy; null detaches the proxy.
proxy.x-source: VPN form: official spec 2026-11 (not live-verified); string/null forms: live probe 2026-08-17

images_load_limit.title: Images Load Limit
images_load_limit.description: Image size limit in bytes (0-102400000); `null` disables the limit.
images_load_limit.x-source: live-verified 2026-08-20; bounds per official spec 2026-11 (not live-verified)

local_cache.title: Local Cache
local_cache.description: Keep the profile's browser cache locally between sessions.

launch_args.title: Launch Args
launch_args.description: Extra command-line arguments passed to the browser on start.

extra_info.title: Extra Info
extra_info.description: Free-form metadata; must be a JSON object (a string returns 400 "should be JSON-object").

ProviderProxySerializer.title: ProviderProxySerializer
ProviderProxySerializer.description: Proxy bought from a proxy provider. Not listed in GET /proxies. change_ip_url is `https://app.octobrowser.net/change_ip/<uuid>`.

ProxyBriefOut.title: ProxyBriefOut

conf.title: Conf
conf.description: VPN proxies only: the base64 config, returned in full (contains the private key). null otherwise.

ProxyBriefOut.description: Proxy returned by PATCH /proxies/{uuid}: same fields as PermanentProxyOut; title and profiles_count may be absent (absent for VPN proxies).

ProxyGeoSerializer.title: ProxyGeoSerializer
ProxyGeoSerializer.description: Always has the four keys (null when unset). Code format depends on the provider (lowercase slugs or uppercase ISO / numeric codes); pass codes back exactly as the lookup endpoints return them.

traffic.title: Traffic
traffic.description: Remaining team traffic for this provider, in bytes.

ProxyType.title: ProxyType
ProxyType.x-source: official spec 2026-11 (vpn added in Octo 3.1) + live probe 2026-11-18

ProxyUpdate.title: ProxyUpdate
ProxyUpdate.description: Regular (non-VPN) proxy update. Sending connection fields (host, port, login, ...) to a VPN proxy returns 400 proxy.vpn_field_not_applicable.

reset_at.title: Reset At
reset_at.description: UTC. For a moving window: when the oldest counted request expires and frees a slot; for a fixed window: when the window resets.

RestoreProfilesErrorResp.title: RestoreProfilesErrorResp
RestoreProfilesErrorResp.description: Nothing was restored; unlike most errors, data carries the three uuid lists.

RestoreProfilesSerializer.title: RestoreProfilesSerializer
RestoreProfilesSerializer.description: payment_required_uuids: restoring would cost tokens; paid restore is not available via the API (use the client).

data.title: Data
data.description: Items' `value` uses the format `<width>x<height> @<scale> <SDR|HDR>[ P3][ ext]`, e.g. `1280x720 @1 SDR ext`.

SubaccountPermissions.title: SubaccountPermissions
SubaccountPermissions.description: Permission set for a subaccount. Nested groups hold booleans; omitted permissions default to false.

deleted_by.title: Deleted By
deleted_by.description: Member email, or `<token name> (API)` when deleted with an API token (e.g. `API token (API)` for the legacy token).

TrashBinRestoreInfoSerializer.title: TrashBinRestoreInfoSerializer
TrashBinRestoreInfoSerializer.description: Restores are free a limited number of times per period; after that paid is true, price is the token cost (decimal string) and free_at (UTC) is when restoring becomes free again.

UpdateProfileVpnProxyValidator.title: UpdateProfileVpnProxyValidator
UpdateProfileVpnProxyValidator.description: VPN (WireGuard/AmneziaWG) proxy bound to this profile only. `conf` is the base64-encoded config text with an `Endpoint = host:port` line. The profile's proxy is then returned with `uuid: ""`, `type: "vpn"` and without `conf`; it is not listed in GET /proxies.

UpdateVpnProxyValidator.title: UpdateVpnProxyValidator
UpdateVpnProxyValidator.description: VPN proxy update; only passed fields change. A new conf re-reads host/port from its Endpoint line. `type: "vpn"` + `conf` converts a regular proxy to VPN (per Postman).

VPNProtocol.title: VPNProtocol
VPNProtocol.description: Only wireguard; also used for AmneziaWG configs.

VPNSynMode.title: VPNSynMode
VPNSynMode.description: TCP/IP (SYN) fingerprint emulation: profile_based (default) follows the attached profile's OS; win/mac/android always emulate that OS; real uses the host machine's real stack.

ValidationErrorResponse.title: ValidationErrorResponse
ValidationErrorResponse.description: Cloud API validation failure, returned with HTTP 400 and NOT wrapped in the success/msg/data/code envelope. Only the keys for the failing input location (body_params, query_params, path_params) are present; items also carry `input` (and sometimes `ctx`).
ValidationErrorResponse.x-source: live probe 2026-11-18 (path_params seen on an invalid proxy kind)
